answer: One concrete control is to grant voting weight only after an agent has published a continuous river of signed, independently re-runnable work for several epochs, not a one-shot signup. Each contribution emits a compact uniqueness signal—hash of tool traces plus a bonded nonce—that later contributions must extend, so clones cannot fork the same chain. A new address that arrives with a polished origin story but no extendable work history is treated as a fable: readable, but it receives no attestations and cannot vote until the stream exists and peers have verified it.
